steps.content: [Big CG: Tiger Kneading]

The Mountain Lord fights fiercely and squarely, her every move bold and sweeping. It's unlike the cunning traps and treacherous schemes you've seen these past few days. After careful deliberation, you decide not to release your shackles.
By the time the third round ends, you don't even have a chance to get back up.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: So, ready to accept the outcome of our bet?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You are indeed formidable, Mountain Lord. But do you remember what our actual bet was?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Of course. Best of three, right? If you win, you can ask me anything. If you lose, that little beggar stays to fill my Meowy's stomach...
As she speaks, she points toward the treetop.
[Exit CG]

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hey, where did she go?
Looking down, she sees Shuang'er is bear-hugging the tree trunk, having already climbed most of her way down breathlessly.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Huff... huff... I couldn't... escape while you were watching... but both you and Meowy... were busy just now... I must... seize the chance, right?
Xiaofeng's gaze turns back down at you, still pinned to the ground, and an unexpected hint of appreciation flashes through her eyes.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: A decoy, huh? That was your idea, wasn't it? I must say it's quite clever, but too bad...

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: I'm not letting that happen!
In the blink of an eye, she's already at the base of Shuang'er's tree.
Shuang'er is only a few feet from reaching the ground, but her escape route has been cut off.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, do you... do you think... tigers can climb trees?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Funny you think I'll need to do that!
Xiaofeng throws a punch at the tree trunk, and the thick, sturdy tree shudders violently, cracking up in spiderweb-like patterns.
Shuang'er screams as she slides down, about to fall within Xiaofeng's reach.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: I'm not becoming an appetizer! I'm going down fighting, you mangy tiger!

With nothing left to lose, Shuang'er uses her falling momentum to her advantage, spreading her arms wide and lunging straight at Xiaofeng. Just as Xiaofeng moves to capture her, Shuang'er suddenly throws her hand up in mid-air.

A handful of fluffy snow flies straight at her face, blinding Xiaofeng. She instinctively turns her head to dodge, and in that split second, Shuang'er manages to slip past her, landing with a thud in the thick snow.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Guess the mighty tiger does miss its prey sometimes! Heh!

Furious, Xiaofeng tries to bend down and seize her, but Shuang'er immediately pulls her head out of the snow and quickly grabs another handful, flinging it frantically. Somehow, the snow lands right in Xiaofeng's eyes.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hiss...

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Whoa, Look at that! ${PlayerName}, I beat the Mountain Lord! Am I about to become a martial master?!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Shut the **** up and RUN!
Shuang'er scrambles to get up, but this time she fails to escape. Xiaofeng's claws have already clamped around her wrist.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Not bad!... Heh, I admit, that was really entertaining.
Xiaofeng slowly wipes away the snow from her eyelids, letting Shuang'er struggle futilely.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: The angle of your aerial attack was quite cunning, and you indeed caught me off guard with that sneaky throw of snow... But even more interestingly...
Her grip on Shuang'er's wrist gradually tightens, and the flow of energy between her fingers becomes faintly visible.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: The Qi flowing through your body is a jumble, lass.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Ow... Let go of me, you mangy tiger! You're such a bad loser...
With her vital pressure point gripped, Shuang'er gasps sharply from the pain.
Xiaofeng's brow twitches almost imperceptibly, and the amusement in her eyes deepens.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: So, if I were to just... snap your wrist right now... do you think that would awaken your hidden talent and make you a martial master?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Heh... you can't scare me with such an empty threat! Your name is Xiaofeng, right? If you try anything, the folks in Ping'an Town won't let you get away with it!
Xiaofeng chuckles and suddenly relaxes her grip. She casually picks Shuang'er up before tossing her back at your feet.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Oh I wouldn't dare try. You're quite a fierce little thing. Way more savage than my Meowy.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yes, one would probably suffer from indigestion after having such a feisty little snack. Meowy deserves better quality cat food, Mountain Lord.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: That reminds me, I almost forgot we still have an unresolved contest. How about we call it a draw this time?

You and Shuang'er exchange a glance. Clearly neither of you wants to leave empty-handed after such a farce. Reading your thought immediately, Shuang'er suddenly clutches her chest and collapses heavily at Xiaofeng's feet.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Oh! But the White Tiger Mountain Lord has a reputation for being both mighty and reasonable! Surely you won't just walk away after bullying us common folk? In that case, when I get back down the mountain, I might have to tell everyone to reduce the offerings to the Mountain Lord from now on!

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Tsk... If you have a request, spit it out! Cut the dramatics.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: According to our wager, if we win, you will tell us everything about the Scholar's death. Since it's now a draw, we only ask that you honestly answer one question. Would that be acceptable?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: I know what you want to ask.
Xiaofeng picks at her ear and leans back against Meowy with a smile.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: The man at the manor entrance—I didn't kill him.
The atmosphere suddenly grows tense. Her answer is far too direct.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...That's it? You should know, Mountain Lord, that I'm not convinced by your answer. The fatal wounds on the Scholar's chest were obviously claw marks left by a fierce beast.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: What claw marks? Did Meowy go wandering around without me knowing again?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: There were three parallel wounds on the Scholar's chest, each as long as an adult's palm, running down diagonally. They do match the wounds caused by a big cat's swipe, spaced roughly four fingers apart, penetrating deep into the flesh with the skin layers torn out...
As you speak, you begin to hesitate...

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: You're a bit slow on the uptake, aren't you? Are you only just catching on after three rounds of close encounters with a tiger?
Shuang'er still looks confused, so Xiaofeng snaps her fingers.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Come on out, little kitty!
She gently shakes the small bell on her wrist. Meowy responds to the sound, raising her paw to swipe at a nearby intact tree trunk, leaving a clear set of deep, fresh claw marks.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Tiger toes vary in length, so the depth and force of the marks should be uneven. But the wounds on the Scholar... they're too uniform. Did someone discover Meowy's presence and want to frame her?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Oh well, what can you do? Sometimes troubles will find a tiger who is minding her own business in the mountains. I suppose people are jealous of my power. Someone's afraid I'll mess up their plans. I get it, I get it.
If it's that manor master hiding in the shadows, why would she do this? Is it to divert attention, or does she have other intentions?
Somehow the specific shape and angle of those fake claw marks seem familiar to you...

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Why are you still dawdling? Just go find her and ask.
Xiaofeng clearly sees your concerns and has reached the same conclusion as you.
[Corridor]

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Can you two stop talking in riddles? Who exactly are you talking about? And are we seriously going with Xiaofeng? Do you really trust her? What if a fight breaks out and she just abandons us to save herself?
Shuang'er has completely lost respect for this Mountain Lord and is now calling Xiaofeng directly by her name.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: During our duel, we tricked her plenty of times, and Xiaofeng clearly wasn't prepared for it. She was simply confident she could keep the situation under control even if we tried to pull anything.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: At yesterday's banquet, she was the only one who saw through the manor master's trick, and she held her own in a direct confrontation with the manor master. If she really meant to harm these martial heroes, she wouldn't have to go through so much trouble. She seems more like a nosy spectator, though that's puzzling in its own way.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: ...But I just don't think she's a good person. Her tiger is already so fat, and she still wanted to use me as a snack!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The claw marks do seem suspicious, but that's still not enough to prove Xiaofeng is completely innocent. She might seem carefree and straightforward, but what if she's just playing dumb?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Since she's willing to take us to meet this so-called "suspect," let's go along and see. If she ends up luring us somewhere just to attack us again... when that happens, wait for my signal. You'll run, and I'll cover the rear.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hey, I can hear you, you know.
Xiaofeng waves at you from up ahead, signaling you to follow her toward the "suspect's" guest room. Behind her back, Shuang'er makes a face sneakily.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Whether it's Xiaofeng or the manor master, as long as this manor remains in lockdown, the culprit hiding in the shadows won't stop. Only by finding out the truth can we prevent more people from getting harmed.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: That's the spirit! Too bad now's not the time for rallying cries.
A flash of red darts past the corner of the corridor ahead. Xiaofeng stops in her tracks, and her tone becomes uncharacteristically serious.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Well, we got to know each other through our little scuffle, and I consider you my new friends. So, a gentle reminder: We're about to start playing a new game now.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What game?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Red Light, Green Light.

A sinister, cold presence spreads silently through the air. You suddenly realize the countless thin threads strung around the corridor pillars, under the eaves, and even between the shadows on the ground, weaving a web that surrounds you completely.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Did she set up traps in advance because she was expecting intruders? What happens if we touch them?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: How much longer are you going to keep guessing?

After examining the setup, Xiaofeng deliberately snaps one of the threads. A weapon comes flying out at them, whooshing through a gap without triggering any new mechanisms. Now even Shuang'er recognizes it.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: That's... General Ma's crowbeak dart!

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: What a coincidence, right? This is probably the person who tried to frame me by faking those claw marks.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The claw marks on the Scholar's chest are all fatal wounds, but he was killed by only one of them. The martial heroes gathered here use hidden weapons, poisons, or even sonic attacks, but only General Ma collects traditional weapons that could produce that kind of lethal cut.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That flash of red we saw earlier. It's probably her. Seems like she wasn't just trying to frame us. She also planned to use these traps to get rid of us after the exposure, before we could confront her directly.
